title: Know Your Identity
body:
Fatihah. Madad, madad.
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.) Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la ilaaha illa-Llah! Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa
lillahi 'l-hamd! O our Lord, yaa Rabbana! You created us, You are granting us everything and no one can
know it fil haal wa fil mastaqbal, now and forever. O our Lord! Forgive us and bless ourselves for the honor of
the most honored one through Your Divinely Presence, Sayyidina Ahmad (s)! Allahumma salli `alaa
Sayyidina Muhammad! Allahumma salli `alaa Sayyidina Ahmad! Allahumma salli `alaa Sayyidina
Mahmood! Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la ilaaha illa-Llah! Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillahi
'l-hamd! That is an honor that we stand up and say Your holy name! O our Lord! You are our Lord. Allah,
Allah. (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
It is a holy night, Friday night, and we hope something new... everything coming that is new, that coming
through holy people; all must be new ones.
O People! As-salaamu `alaykum our listeners; listen and respect. I'm such a weak servant, don't look at my
weakness. The Lord of Heavens is asking to give any creature. He created for worthing?? As it is mentioned in
the Holy Qur'an, when the armies of Sayyidina Sulayman were passing from one land to another land, he was
on his way, and he reached Wadi an-Naml, the Valley of Ants, and he was asking one ant to warn whole ants

through that big valley. The ants were not looking at that warning coming from one ant like themselves, but
they were looking to who was that one making that small ant to warn that huge valley of ants. And Heavenly
Protection was coming on them and they were speedily going through their holes, their living places.
Therefore, don't say, "What is this old person saying? Something we are not understanding!" Ants
understanding from ants, and you are not understanding from man to man? I am only a weak servant like an
ant, and the Lord of Heavens making people hear from one weakest servant a warning. Heavenly warning
coming now. Don't look to me; I am nothing, but He is making me to come to you and addressing you.
O listeners! Who is making them to not listen, because they are knowing if they are listening, they must
believe, and who believing, they must act. But people now are under Shaytanic hegemony, and he is ordering
people who are under his hegemony, "O my followers, you must not listen except to what I teach to you." And
every knowledge that people are learning now, from high schools, colleges, through universities and up, are
all Shaytanic teachings, and Shaytan's maqsad, his aim is to make people to hear and to listen to what he is
saying.
It is mentioned through Holy Qur'an that Allah Almighty is giving the highest honor to Mankind by sending
His last message, the Holy Qur'an, to people to make them on the Straight Path, reaching to His Heavenly
Presence. Allah Almighty is not in need of what servants are doing, but He is asking to grant His creatures
from His endless territories and through endless territories there are countless oceans, Oceans of Creation.
He is Allah! You must believe. What are you doing here?
"O my darling! We must buy, we must change our old-fashioned car."
"O my darling, you think we may change our old-fashion car? You think that I am preferring?"
"What? What you look and say, if we change our old-fashion car with a truck?"
"O my darling, who can drive a truck?"
"No, we are not driving. We may sit and we may sleep in it also, and one driver may drive, and if anyone
asking we just say we are changing our house to a new house and therefore, we are changing to new-fashion
truck and new furniture, and we are fearing no one coming to steal them. Therefore, my darling, I am
sleeping in it overnight. And because both of them over 90 coming like one saying and second one
understanding wrong. One speaking wrong and other one understanding that it is right!"

"Yes, we may discuss that important point until overnight."
"O my darling, I am tired, I must sleep."
"Doesn't matter we may continue through our dreams that we have a truck."
People now are looking in this very short lifetime to change their cars, to change their homes, their furniture,
and all of them nonsense! We are making you to sleep? Are you tired? (No.) (Mawlana laughs.) Very
important people, like that couple, occupying themselves with nonsense.
O People! Allah Almighty sent 124,000 messengers from the heavens, coming to you to make clear your lives'
aims and for what you have been created. All 124,000 were the same, (warning,) "O People! Don't worry or
run after such foolish demands, and death is running after you." You don't know if you are sleeping, death
coming up to morning. If you are standing, going to night time you may be a dead one. You are never
thinking on it! That is source of troubles for people living now because they are wasting their energies, their
activities, and their whole efforts for something that is just veiled, closed for where you are going. You are not
knowing. You are finding a big curtain in front of you and you are running on it, saying, "We must run."
O People! Some of you are reaching an end. You may see in front of you something like curtains closed in a
theater; you see something behind, and people are very anxious to see what is behind that curtain.
O People! You must think what is happening to Mankind. They are living, living, living and everyday
thousands, perhaps millions of people are disappearing. Why are you not asking where they are going? You
are bringing them to the cemetery and putting them in the graveyard. Why are you not asking where they are
going? They were like you --running, running, running-- then they were fighting (dying?) and you were
taking them to the cemetery, graveyard. That one was running, asking to do something, making that high
building, skyscraper; yesterday he was making so many projects for new building*. Even they were thinking
for holy land of Mecca al-Mukarramah, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, where they are destroying old
buildings and making new ones. Center for Salafi `ulama, I think your center should be in Mecca alMukarrama! And you are saying nothing about people, for their efforts wasting, only using for building
(construction). You are knowing the Holy Qur'an, so why you are not saying? I am not shouting now for Pope,
no; they are keeping their buildings as they were, but you are building for what?
O People! Listen and try to understand what is coming to my tongue to speak to you. I have been ordered, it

is not my wish or my will to sit here and address you. No, but the holy ones, saying to be holy ones through
ummah, who are you? (They answer,) "We are Salafi `ulama. No 'holy ones' just mentioned through the Holy
Qur'an." Please say it for me, it is Arabic (which you speak), not Turkish or Persian language, so please say it
for me. You are understanding, but you are going against, and the Holy Qur'an giving everything for here and
Hereafter! Don't make mahzada, joking! No, no! We are on Earth now, tomorrow under the Earth, and our
physical being and our souls getting up. And for every soul there is one entrance. Everyone must reach to
their special entrance because our souls going up to holy lands of the heavens, yes, going there!
O People! You must think that one day you are going up from this life, angels carrying our souls, not carrying
our physical being, as no value for our physical being. That value for our souls may go there. Therefore,
everything you may find through the Holy Qur'an. Holy ones getting up, not unholy ones. If a person not
reaching to be a holy one, can't pass up; that one must be thrown down, if reaching on Earth, that earth
swallowing, to reach center of this world, there is another fire there.
O People! am not speaking to your asaateeru 'l-awwaleen, As people, unbelievers they were saying, when
their prophets addressing to them. They are going to say "we are not believing in such things," saying, "it is
such an old history." Don’t take prophets' messages or declarations that just reached to prophets from
heavens, don't deny. They are like an ocean, but oceans of Holy Quran swallowing all other oceans.
Once, Jesus Christ (pbuh) was always traveling to meet so many people, they can't reach to him. But he was
running through the lands of the Lord of Heavens to meet people and to speak to them, to make them to
understand something for themselves and this universe, and what is beyond it.
Now, millions of people are not knowing their identities. "Who are you?" I am asking, and so many people
they are muta'ajib, astonished at that question, "Who are you?"
"Who are you?"
"You don't know who I am?"
"I am Salafi `ulama," or "I am king in Persia or Turkey, you understand?"
No any inshaan, sign, I am not looking any different being between myself and between yourself, and I am
looking at you saying, "Who are you?"
"I am chief medic," or "I am sultan for this country or that country."

I am looking and I am only seeing a skeleton. You must understand about yourself. Jesus Christ was teaching
people to understand about themselves.
"Who am I? I am Alexander!"
"O Alexander, any special difference between you and your name? If anyone saying you are not Iskandar or
Alexander, but you are Phillipus, what are you going to say? Your name is written or your chest or on your
forehead? What you are going to say? That is your identity? Prophets came to tell people about themselves,
about their positions, about their... but people are not listening. He was saying, 'I am Jesus Christ, I have
been sent by the Lord of Heavens, Creator of all Creation.'"
"What do you mean?"
"Sit down, I may have some information about that and I may be with you for some time to teach you about
yourself, about Jesus Christ, and about your Creator."
Once he was like this, going about on a high mountain. He was one person, he have ... and putting on him
and he was in a place (where) sun shining on him. And Jesus Christ was saying, "O my Lord's servant, what
you are doing here?"
And he was saying, "You are saying this and you have a special being, and you have a special secret about
your Lord's Creation, how you are saying to me? And what are you doing here? You don't know that One Who
created me, created for His servanthood? O Jesus, the son of Man, no father for you, you are created through
the womb of your mum to be created as a miracle for people. You are asking me such a question, 'What you
are doing here?' You don't know for what we have been created?"
Jesus Christ was saying, "I know, I know. But for teaching people for what you have been created, to be a
servant for your Lord, for your Creator. But they are not understanding from me. I am on level high, but from
you, you are on same level and they will understand. You are always here day and night asking."
"Yes Jesus Christ, I am here as you see, if you are coming in the middle of the night, or you can find me
midday; if you are coming here you may find me. Not even small place to be here, or you may keep yourself,
saying, 'O Jesus Christ.'"
Jesus Christ was saying, "O, you are such a servant and you are saying for 700 years nothing for Eternity.
Therefore, I must keep that time for my Lord's servanthood? O servant of my Lord, should come after me that

I am giving good tidings about himself, Sayyidina Ahmad. (Mawlana stands.) Sayyidina Muhammad's (s)
nations according to his teachings should be between 60 and 70 years. But mostly people whose ages between
60 and 70 years are passing, but I am looking and in such a short time they are building buildings as those of
Nimrod. What are you saying?"
"O Jesus, our Lord's miraculous servant, if I was through that ummah, that nation of the Seal of Prophets, I
was making only one sajdah and remaining through sajdah up to day that my soul just be taken up to my
Lord's Divinely Presence"
O Salafi `ulamas, what are real ones saying about that building in Mecca al-mukarramah and Madinatul-alMunawarra? No, you are fearing from the malik, under malik you are fearing to say that it is forbidden in
Islam to build more than two floors high. Even angels are saying that when a person is asking to build over
two floors high, they say, "Till where are you going, up and up?"
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, SubhaanAllah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, SultaanAllah
Dome dome, dome dome, dome dome, dome dome 8x
Fatihah.
(48 minutes) More tonight getting for bombarding heedless people. I am running to my Lord (to be?) from
being a heedless one, alhamdulillah. Alhamdulillah today they are getting up as He likes, according to our
actions making them to hear, to listen, and to understand, to obey as He likes. I am asking forgiveness for me
and for others. May Allah forgives us, all of us `alimullah. It is something more to wake up people!
Fatihah.

* launched world's tallest building, "Burj Khalifah" in Dubai on 6 January 2010
